# classic-laddie: declare the valley attest signing env

Small, surgical change. In `hosts/classic-laddie/default.nix`, declare two
session environment variables so the `valley` CLI's `[a]sk` verb can sign
attestations (the tool is deliberately config-less; the environment is its
interface, and until now these were only ever exported ad hoc):

- `VALLEY_ATTEST_KEY` → the default user's `~/.ssh/id_ed25519` (derive the
  home path from the existing user config idiom — `config.cosmo.user.default`
  is used throughout this file — rather than hardcoding `/home/patrick` if the
  repo offers a clean way; otherwise the literal path is acceptable, this is a
  single-user host).
- `VALLEY_ATTEST_NAME` → `"patrick"`.

There is already an `environment.sessionVariables.GDK_DPI_SCALE` setting in
this file (~line 110) — put these near it or merge into one attribute set,
whichever reads better in context.

Comment (terse, one or two lines max, repo idiom is high-density): the reason
NAME must be set is that qinling's identity registry (identity/registry.cue in
the qinling repo) publishes this key as signing under "patrick", not under the
attest helper's default name (this host's attestations name) — a note signed
under an unpublished name is one no verifier can find a key for. Same
rationale as the `signingName` comment on `services.valley.integrator` further
down this file; a cross-reference to it is enough, don't restate the essay.

## Constraints

- Touch ONLY `hosts/classic-laddie/default.nix`. No other files.
- Do not touch secrets, keys.nix, or the valley service config.

## Acceptance

- `nix flake check` passes — paste the final lines.
- `nix build --dry-run .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.system.build.toplevel`
  evaluates cleanly — paste the tail.
- `git diff --stat` in the report.
- Open a normal PR. Do not merge.
